proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind. types.ts defines only SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom and the survey queue includes magic_item units, but no corresponding TypeScript record type, mechanics header, or payload family exists. All magic items are blocked at this level.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_floor
proposed_widenings.justification: Life Preservation sets a minimum roll value of 10 on death saving throws. This is mechanically distinct from modify_roll_numeric (additive delta) and modify_roll_advantage (advantage/disadvantage). A floor/clamp atom is needed to express 'treat any roll below N as N'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you make a Death Saving Throw, you can change a roll of 9 or lower to a 10, turning a failed save into a successful one.

proposed_widenings.name: death_saving_throw window or filter on save_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: Life Preservation fires specifically on death saving throws, which are not saves against a caster DC but a fixed-DC survival mechanic. No window atom or save-gate variant targets this event.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you make a Death Saving Throw

proposed_widenings.name: hit_die_window
proposed_widenings.justification: Natural Healing Boost fires when a creature rolls a Hit Point Die (spends a Hit Die during a rest). No existing window atom covers Hit Die expenditure. rest_window covers rest completion, not the individual die roll within a rest.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you roll a Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points

proposed_widenings.name: modify_hp_multiplier (or scale_heal_multiplier)
proposed_widenings.justification: Natural Healing Boost doubles the HP restored by a Hit Die roll. This is a multiplier effect — not a fixed heal amount, not a numeric addend, not a die-size or die-count change. No existing effect or scaling atom models HP multiplication.
proposed_widenings.evidence: double the number of Hit Points it restores

proposed_widenings.name: attunement requirement on MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: The item requires attunement. The v4 taxonomy has attune (procedure) and attunement_slot (resource), but the surface has no field or type modeling whether a magic item requires attunement and how many slots it consumes.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no MagicItemRecord in UnitRecord. Even if that were added, two atom gaps remain (modify_roll_floor for the death save minimum, hit_die_window + HP multiplier for the healing boost). The death save floor mechanic is also novel enough to require a new window variant. All three mechanics of this item require widenings beyond what the current surface can honestly express.
